title: Integration Consultant
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Integration Consultant with strong enterprise application integration expertise to support the implementation of Adrenaline HCM and integrate it with various enterprise applications across GCC and other regions.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain inbound and outbound enterprise integrations.

Integrate HCM with ERP, Finance, Banking, Payroll, WPS and Attendance systems.

Build integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, JSON, XML, CSV and SFTP.

Work with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SAP CPI or Azure Integration Services.

Perform data mapping, transformation, validation and migration activities.

Conduct integration testing, troubleshoot issues and provide go-live and post-implementation support.

Prepare technical design documents, interface specifications and integration documentation.

Ensure data security, encryption, access control and integration reliability.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of experience in Enterprise Application Integration.

Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, SOAP APIs and Web Services.

Experience with at least one middleware/integration platform (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI, Informatica, etc.).

Strong SQL and database knowledge (Oracle / SQL Server).

Knowledge of Python, Java, C#, JavaScript or PowerShell.

Experience with OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates and secure file transfers.

Excellent communication, analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Experience:

Experience integrating HCM/Payroll platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM or PeopleSoft.

GCC experience with WPS, banking and payroll integrations.

ERP integration experience with Oracle, SAP or Microsoft Dynamics.

Exposure to Azure AD / Entra ID and Single Sign-On (SSO).

Experience working with international teams across different time zones.

title: Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect**
with strong hands-on expertise in designing, architecting, and engineering LLM-powered and agentic AI solutions.

The candidate should also be comfortable working in the
**US EST time zone**
to ensure close collaboration with the client team. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building and orchestrating AI agents, integrating LLMs, designing agent runtimes, implementing tool integrations, and establishing scalable, secure, and governed AI platforms. This role requires someone who can evaluate existing agentic AI architectures, understand platform dependencies, define technical standards, establish evaluation frameworks, and identify gaps in safety, security, and AI governance. The candidate should be equally comfortable with architecture-level decisions and hands-on technical implementation.

**Work Schedule:**
Must be flexible and willing to work in the US Eastern Standard Time (EST) time zone.

**Responsibilities include:**

**Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Design and architect scalable, enterprise-grade agentic AI platforms and solutions.
* Define agent orchestration patterns, runtime architecture, workflows, and multi-agent communication mechanisms.
* Architect prompt engineering frameworks, tool calling, connectors, and model integration strategies.
* Design memory management, state persistence, and context management mechanisms.
* Evaluate and implement RAG architectures and vector database integrations wherever applicable.

**LLM & AI Integration**

* Design and integrate LLM-based applications using leading commercial and open-source models.
* Establish model integration patterns, routing, fallback mechanisms, and model selection strategies.
* Define reusable components and frameworks for agent development and deployment.
* Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and token consumption.

**AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Observability**

* Define evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Establish mechanisms for testing prompts, tools, workflows, and end-to-end agent behaviour.
* Implement telemetry, monitoring, tracing, and observability for agentic systems.
* Define mechanisms to identify hallucinations, failures, and performance bottlenecks.

**AI Safety, Security & Governance**

* Identify and address security and governance gaps in agentic AI architectures.
* Establish guardrails for responsible AI implementation, including access controls and data protection.
* Define policies for tool permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent execution boundaries.
* Ensure appropriate compliance, auditability, and governance standards are incorporated into the architecture.

**Technical Leadership & Architecture Assessment**

* Assess existing AI and agentic platform architectures and map technical dependencies.
* Identify architecture gaps, integration challenges, scalability risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend target-state architecture and implementation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.

Primary Skills :

* 5+ years of experience in software architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles, including recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic AI systems.
* Strong understanding of agent orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, multi-agent systems, and workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, function calling, and tool orchestration.
* Experience designing memory, state management, context handling, and RAG-based architectures.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of AI security, governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to assess complex architectures, identify dependencies, and recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Secondary Skills :

* Experience with frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI ecosystems such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Azure AI Search.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation tools, tracing, and monitoring frameworks.
* Experience designing enterprise AI platforms with security, scalability, and cost optimization considerations.

title: Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Manages a platform team’s operational outcomes; provides technical/functional leadership for shared services, SDKs, and integration frameworks. Ensures adherence to compatibility, rollout, and security standards; resolves moderately complex cross-service issues. Guides team-level observability, capacity planning, and resilience improvements. Communicates scope and trade-offs to related teams; tracks platform adoption and developer experience within the team’s remit.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Software Development:**

* Operate a platform team roadmap that enforces compatibility, versioning, and safe rollout policies for shared services and SDKs.
* Drive team-level observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns; ensure adherence during releases.
* Coordinate cross-team incident response for platform issues, ensuring downstream consumer safety and clear remediation paths.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Manages team and may contribute to the design and development of code and software solutions and identifies and analyzes requirements.
* Provides coaching and process execution for team to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews to drive improvements.
* Leads and reviews team to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues within a single component or functional area.
* Ensures team implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Leverages prior experience and analysis to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Guides team in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Manages team to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Manages team to design and develop software, systems, and services.
* Provides technical leadership and technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Guides team and conducts periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders within own group to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities
* Implements performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Impacts immediate team to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* May collaborate and communicate with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* Manages team to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
* Enables direct reports to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Communicates regularly with stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Provides guidance to team on processes for handling customer issues and/or defects and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
* Investigates and troubleshoots product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team and other stakeholders to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
* Ensures team adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
* Implements moderately complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Manages team to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching for (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Guides team to follow standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and drive improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets when applicable to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align expectations and shared objectives. Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture.

**Problem Solving:**

* Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identifies and recommends improvements as well as encourages team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Reviews and provides feedback on team members’ ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

**Performance and Development:**

* Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Facilitates goal setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. Contributes to the talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, assessing promotion eligibility, and managing talent resources.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in DevOps practices, particularly in the banking domain, and will be responsible for implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes environments. As a DevOps Engineer, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our software development lifecycle by automating processes and ensuring seamless integration and delivery of applications. You will collaborate closely with development and operations teams to streamline workflows and improve system reliability. Key Responsibilities: - Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery processes. - Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement DevOps best practices. - Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure high availability and reliability. - Continuously improve deployment processes and infrastructure. - Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies in DevOps and cloud computing. Required Skills: - Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration. - Proficiency in CI/CD tools and practices. - Familiarity with cloud platforms and infrastructure as code. - Understanding of the banking domain and its specific requirements. - Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. If you are passionate about DevOps and looking to make a significant impact in the banking sector, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

* Deep Expertise Development: Cultivate an in-depth understanding of Confluent’s technologies and the intricacies of building streaming applications.
* Technical Discovery and POC/Pilot Solutions: Collaborate with Confluent solutions engineers to gather requirements, identify use cases, and facilitate the development of Proof of Concept (POC)/Pilot solutions. Aid customers in overcoming technical challenges during initial blueprinting and use case deployment.
* Prospect Demos and Evangelization: Collaborate seamlessly with Confluent's Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to bring our offerings to new prospects. Craft and deliver tailored demos that go beyond the standard, showcasing the unique value proposition Confluent has to offer.
* Customer Engagement: Offer technical assistance in driving customer consumption through monthly customer health reports, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Quarterly Technical Reviews.
* Knowledge Sharing, Workshops, and Training: Support cross-functional teams, including Field Marketing, Partner Solutions by conducting training sessions and workshops/webinars for customers, partners, prospects, and internal teams to educate them on Confluent's platform/cloud, features, and best practices.
* RFP/Vendor risk assessment Support: Contribute to vendor risk assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of potential risks and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Assist in answering Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs).
* Technical Artifact Creation and Maintenance: Architect, build, and maintain reusable artifacts, including tools, prototypes, demos, workshops, and architecture blueprints.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre-sales capacity.
* Process & Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.
  
  

* First-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment & Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering & Integration).
* Clear, consistent demonstration of self-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must
* Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities to all levels across an organization.
* Ability to explain complex concepts in plain, non-technical language that resonates with mid-level managers and business owners.
* Fluency in English is a requisite.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Previous experience building solutions with Apache Kafka.
* Understanding of systems operations concepts (disk, network, operating systems, etc).
* Experience with software development tools, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus
* Experience building and operating large scale systems.
* Experience in technical pre-sales or consultative roles.

title: PHP-Engineering Manager

title: DevOps Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
DevOps Engineer / Platform Engineer
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and managing the organization's application delivery platforms and infrastructure components. The role focuses on CI/CD pipeline management, container orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, security integration, and operational excellence. The individual will work closely with development, infrastructure, security, andcloudteams to ensure efficient, secure, and scalable application deployment and operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CI/CD DevOps Management**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment processes.
* Manage and administer DevOps platforms, repositories, build agents, and runners.
* Automate application deployment, testing, and release processes.
* Implement DevSecOps practices within CI/CD workflows.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and deployment issues.
* Optimize build and deployment performance.

**Container Kubernetes Platform Administration**

* Deploy, manage, and maintain containerized application platforms.
* Administer Kubernetes environments including:

+ Rancher
+ Red Hat OpenShift (OCP)

* Configure namespaces, ingress controllers, storage classes, RBAC, and cluster security.
* Monitor cluster health, capacity, and performance.
* Manage container image repositories and lifecycle.

**Docker Administration**

* Build, secure, and manage Docker container environments.
* Define and maintain approved base images.
* Implement container security best practices.
* Support application teams in containerization initiatives.

**Linux Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.
* Perform system hardening, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Manage operating system performance and availability.
* Maintain platform documentation and configuration standards.

**Middleware Platform Services**
**Administer And Support**

* HAProxy
* Nexus Repository Manager
* Keycloak Identity and Access Management
* Access Manager solutions
* HashiCorp Vault

**Responsibilities Include**

* Installation and configuration
* Security hardening
* High availability implementation
* Certificate management
* Backup and recovery
* Performance tuning

**Security Secrets Management**

* Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Manage secrets, certificates, tokens, and credentials using HashiCorp Vault.
* Integrate security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards.
* Coordinate vulnerability remediation activities.

**Logging, Monitoring Observability**

* Implement and manage centralized logging platforms such as:

+ ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
+ Graylog

* Create dashboards, alerts, and monitoring solutions.
* Perform log analysis and troubleshooting.
* Support incident investigation and root cause analysis.

**CloudPlatform Support**

* Support deployment and operations oncloudplatforms:
* Configurecloud-native services supporting DevOps operations.
* Assist incloudinfrastructure automation and optimization.
* Support hybridcloudand container-based deployments.

**Automation Infrastructure as Code**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and platform configuration.
* Develop scripts and reusable automation components.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using approved tools.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation.

**Platform Reliability Operations**

* Ensure high availability and resilience of platform services.
* Participate in incident management and problem management activities.
* Maintain disaster recovery and backup procedures.
* Create and maintain operational runbooks and SOPs.

**Experience**

* Up to 3 years ( 2 candidates) , 3-5 years ( 1 Candidate) of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Hands-on experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience administering Kubernetes platforms in enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting containerized applications and platform services.
* Experience with Linux system administration and middleware platforms.

**Technical Skills**
**Mandatory**

* CI/CD Pipeline Design Management
* Git-based Source Control Systems
* Build Runners and Agents Administration
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Rancher
* Red Hat OpenShift (OCP)
* HAProxy
* Nexus Repository Manager
* Keycloak
* Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
* Scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar)

**Preferred**

* HashiCorp Vault
* Access Manager Solutions
* ELK Stack
* Graylog
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)
* DevSecOps Toolchains

This job is provided by Shine.com
